<p align="center"><strong>Discovery - why the house appears on Halloween.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">Beneath the notice is an older warning: &quot;On All Hallows' Eve, the boundary thins. Mother Hollow may knock twelve times. A living invitation gives her the thirteenth.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">&quot;She keeps her guests by taking their names. Do not answer her call. Do not eat at her table. A jack-o'-lantern is a face she has already borrowed.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">Elias has written across the bottom: &quot;My beacon held the threshold. I let it fail. The key protects your name while you repair it, unless you willingly give it away.&quot;</p>
